D073.people: Father (bald, dark shirt) walking a shaded gravel trail pulling a red bike trailer; a small child ahead of him on the path
D073.event: A walk/ride on a wooded rail-trail, father hauling the kid trailer
D073.notes: Distant, back-of-the-scene framing on a long green corridor of trail; the red trailer is the story object. Quiet pandemic-spring outdoor routine.

D074.people: Mother (dark hair) in a selfie on a wooden dock with two young daughters, one in a pink bike helmet, one in a white hoodie
D074.event: Rest stop on a dock over the water during a bike ride
D074.notes: Easy, unforced smiles; the still-buckled pink helmet dates it to the middle of an outing rather than a posed stop. Water and dock planks give it depth.

D075.people: Two young daughters in an inflatable backyard pool, one seated on a unicorn float
D075.event: Playing in a blow-up pool set up on the back lawn
D075.notes: Shot wide from the lawn, so the girls are small in frame. A very specific 2020 artifact: the summer the backyard had to be the whole vacation.

D076.people: Father walking hand-in-hand with a young daughter toward the water; a second child crouched on the shore behind them
D076.event: Walking down to the edge of a lake
D076.notes: Backs to the camera, the held hand at the center of the frame, wide empty lake and treeline beyond. Reads as a classic parent-and-child silhouette without being posed.

D077.people: An adult sitting in the shallows with two girls wading; other beachgoers small in the background
D077.event: Wading at a rocky lake beach
D077.notes: Composition is dominated by the empty rocky foreground; the people are small and faces are not readable. Documentary value only.

D078.people: Shirtless father and two daughters in swimsuits running across the back lawn of a house
D078.event: Running around the yard in swimsuits, apparently water play
D078.notes: Motion caught mid-run with the house and deck filling the top half; nobody is looking at the camera. Everyday backyard mayhem rather than an event.

D079.people: Two daughters leaning over a car seat back with their faces close to the lens; the father grinning between the headrests behind them
D079.event: Goofing around in the car, faces crammed into a selfie
D079.notes: A grey headrest blocks the bottom third and the exposure is flat, but the squeezed-shut eyes and the father's grin behind make it genuinely funny. Keep despite the technical mess.

D080.people: Mother in a patterned swimsuit standing at the surf line holding a young daughter's hand; a crowded beach behind them
D080.event: A day at a busy ocean beach
D080.notes: Posed for the camera with strangers and umbrellas cluttering the background. Pleasant but interchangeable with other beach frames in this run.

D081.people: Mother and father standing side by side on a pool diving board, both in swimsuits, white fence and pines behind
D081.theme: Growing older; Everyday life; The life we built
D081.notes: Straight-on posed couple shot; the mother's midsection reads as a rounded early bump, consistent with the clearly visible pregnancy two weeks later on the same summer's beach frames.

D082.people: Father alone in a beach selfie, ball cap, no shirt, headphone cord; unrelated beachgoers and surf behind him
D082.event: Selfie during a solo walk or run on the beach
D082.notes: Casual one-off self-portrait with the horizon tilted and the subject cropped at the chin. No narrative content beyond 'he was at the beach.'

D083.people: Mother in a blue patterned swimsuit standing in the surf with two young daughters pressed against her legs
D083.event: Standing in the shallow surf together at the ocean
D083.notes: The girls cling to her hips with their backs half-turned while she smiles down the lens; low camera angle makes her the anchor of the frame. Physical affection, not a pose.

D084.people: Close beach selfie of the couple, mother in dark sunglasses, father shirtless in mirrored sunglasses
D084.notes: Tight, well-lit, both genuinely smiling, but it is one of several near-identical couple selfies in this stretch of the archive.

D085.people: Mother visibly pregnant in a floral swimsuit, father in blue trunks, and two daughters (one held on his hip, one standing in front)
D085.event: Beach portrait late in the third pregnancy
D085.theme: Family growth; Becoming parents; Vacations; Family of four
D085.notes: The clearest 'family of four, about to be five' frame in the batch: the bump is unmistakable and both older girls are in the shot. A natural hinge point in the documentary.

D086.people: Masked mother with a small daughter and masked father with another daughter, seated on the front steps of a house with an infant car-seat carrier between them
D086.event: Parents and daughters on the front steps with a newborn carrier, everyone in masks
D086.theme: Becoming parents; Family growth; Home; Milestones
D086.notes: Two weeks after the visible pregnancy, a car-seat carrier sits on the steps between the parents; the baby's face is not visible in the frame. The masks date it precisely to the pandemic hospital era.

D087.people: Mother lying on the floor with an infant in a 'Milk Monster' onesie on her chest and two older daughters in Halloween costumes stretched out on either side
D087.event: Halloween on the living room floor with the new baby
D087.theme: Holidays; Motherhood; Family growth; Family of five
D087.notes: Shot from directly overhead with all four laid out in a row on the rug — the newborn's first Halloween, in costume, with her sisters. The bird's-eye framing is unlike anything else in the batch.

D088.people: No people; a snow-covered deck seen through a glass door, with small purple and teal kids' chairs buried in snow
D088.event: Documenting a heavy snowfall from inside the house
D088.notes: A weather snapshot through a foggy sliding door — no people, no action. Only the abandoned kid-sized chairs hint at a family.

D089.people: Mother and one daughter cheek to cheek in knit beanies, snow and bare trees behind
D089.event: Selfie together outside in the snow
D089.notes: Tight two-shot, both grinning wide with matching pom hats; the closeness of the heads carries real warmth. Winter light is clean and even.

D090.people: Mother seated at a round picnic table with a girl reaching toward her; a second child partly out of frame at the table
D090.event: Snack or craft time at an outdoor pavilion by a playground
D090.notes: Shot from a distance along the bench line so the table and empty seating dominate; faces are turned away. Ordinary-day texture, weak as a standalone frame.

D091.people: A dark-haired woman who reads as the mother and an older grey-haired man standing by a stone fireplace, with three girls in front — the eldest holding the baby
D091.event: Indoor gathering by the fireplace, the older sisters holding the baby
D091.theme: Family growth; Sisterhood; Home; Family of five
D091.notes: The older man is not the father (who is shaved-headed) and reads as a grandparent, though I cannot confirm. The sisters carefully holding the baby is the real content.

D092.people: Mother, an older man in a suit, an older woman holding the baby in pink, and the father in a pink shirt standing behind three daughters in spring dresses
D092.event: Dressed-up spring holiday gathering outdoors, likely Easter given the date and clothes
D092.notes: Three generations lined up on grass with a parking lot behind; the baby is held by an older woman who reads as a grandmother. Posed but useful as a family-tree establishing shot.

D093.people: Mother, father holding the youngest daughter in a sun hat, and two older daughters in swimsuits in front, at the ocean
D093.event: Family beach portrait, all five together
D093.theme: Family of five; Vacations; Family growth
D093.notes: The counterpart to the pregnant beach frame a year earlier — same shoreline setup, now with the third daughter on the father's arm. Reads as a deliberate annual marker.

D094.people: Mother in a dark dress holding the infant in a white gown, father in a blue suit, and two daughters seated between them in front of a large flower arrangement
D094.event: A formal indoor occasion with the baby in a white gown and ceremonial flowers, consistent with a christening or similar rite
D094.theme: Milestones; Family of five; Family growth
D094.notes: Everyone dressed formally and seated on steps with a sunflower arrangement behind; the white infant gown is the tell. I cannot confirm the specific ceremony from the frame.

D095.people: Mother and father in a street selfie; he is wearing a white cap, aviators and a costume-style jacket with a false moustache look
D095.event: Halloween, the parents in costume outside on the street
D095.notes: Both are clearly enjoying the bit; the costume is the joke and the parked cars and pavement place it mid trick-or-treat. Sharp and well exposed.

D096.people: Father holding the youngest daughter, mother beside him, and two daughters in cheerleader costumes, in front of a house and minivan; the adults in matching team outfits
D096.event: Halloween in coordinated sports-team costumes before trick-or-treating
D096.notes: A whole-family themed costume in the driveway, plastic pumpkin buckets already in hand. Snapshot lighting but the group coordination is the point.

D097.people: Father in a black 'Ken' T-shirt with three daughters in Barbie-print tops crowded around him in a kitchen
D097.event: A Barbie-themed party, apparently a birthday, at home
D097.notes: The dad wearing a 'Ken' shirt to his daughters' Barbie party is the whole joke and it lands; the toddler is pressed into the middle of the huddle. Kitchen clutter visible at the edges.

D098.people: The youngest daughter alone, a toddler on a grey couch in a 'Juicy' top, holding a lemon
D098.event: Close portrait of the toddler at home
D098.notes: Direct, unblinking eye contact with soft window light and a clean shallow-depth background. The strongest single-child portrait on these sheets.

D099.people: Father holding the toddler, mother beside him, and two daughters in matching red plaid dresses in front of a decorated Christmas tree
D099.event: Christmas Eve portrait by the tree
D099.notes: Well-lit and everyone smiling at the lens, but it is the standard annual tree portrait; a baby gate is still up at the left. Low uniqueness by design.

D100.people: A woman who reads as the mother standing at a breakfast-nook table, a girl seated at the table, the toddler clinging to a chair, and another girl in the doorway
D100.event: An ordinary morning in the kitchen nook, nobody posing
D100.notes: Fully candid and slightly messy — a coat on the bench, a bag in the doorway, three kids moving in different directions. Exactly the daily texture the posed frames leave out.

D101.people: Mother, father and three daughters posed on a stage in front of a blue curtain, the girls in matching floral dresses
D101.event: Family photo on stage after a school or dance performance
D101.notes: Stage risers and a curtain place it at a recital rather than a studio; the parents' outfits echo the girls'. Flat stage lighting.

D102.people: Father, mother and three daughters lined along a resort balustrade with a marina and palms behind
D102.event: Family portrait at a tropical resort at the start of a vacation
D102.notes: Bright midday sun with hard shadows on the stone; everyone lined up shoulder to shoulder. Establishes the resort trip that fills the next several frames.

D103.people: Mother and three daughters in swim shirts and cover-ups posed in a large resort lobby hall
D103.event: Posed stop in the resort lobby on the way to the water
D103.notes: The vast columned hallway dwarfs them, which is the most interesting thing about the frame. Standard vacation line-up otherwise.

D104.people: Father bent double under a palm tree, holding the toddler's hands as she stands in the sand; his back and shorts fill the top of the frame
D104.event: Helping the youngest walk in the sand at the beach
D104.notes: Badly composed — the father is headless and his backside dominates the frame — but the tenderness of the two held hands survives it. Keep for the accident of the framing.

D105.people: An adult in a wetsuit (reads as the mother, sunglasses, hair pulled back) standing in shallow turquoise water with the three daughters, all in matching wetsuits
D105.event: Suited up in the shallows for a water excursion, apparently a snorkel or marine encounter
D105.notes: Matching rented wetsuits on all four make it clearly an organized excursion rather than a swim. The toddler in a full wetsuit is the detail that sells it.

D106.people: Mother in a long dress and father in a red polo posed indoors in front of a window with an ocean and golf-course view
D106.event: Couple portrait before dinner on vacation
D106.theme: Vacations; Growing together; The life we built
D106.notes: Posed with arms around each other; the resort interior and bright window make for a slightly blown background. A pleasant but ordinary date-night frame.

D107.people: Father standing chest-deep in clear turquoise water with both arms raised, the three daughters hanging off him and floating around him
D107.event: Playing in the sea, the father hoisting all three girls at once
D107.theme: Fatherhood; Vacations; Humor; Family of five
D107.notes: Arms up in triumph with a daughter clamped to each side and the youngest floating in front in pink armbands — genuine, physical joy. Bright water, clean exposure, holds the screen easily.

D108.people: Mother crouched in shallow clear water with the three daughters clustered against her
D108.event: Sitting in the shallows together at the beach
D108.notes: The mirror image of the father-in-the-water frame from the same day, quieter and further from the lens. All four heads at water level.

D109.people: Mother and father in a selfie at a beachside table with a plate of food and a takeaway box, sea and umbrella behind
D109.event: Lunch together by the water on vacation
D109.notes: The food on the table and the empty chairs give it the feel of a rare kid-free meal. Faces are well lit but the framing is tight and casual.

D110.people: Mother and father in a beach selfie, both in sunglasses, big cloud-filled sky and turquoise sea behind them
D110.event: Couple selfie on the beach on vacation
D110.theme: Vacations; Growing together; The life we built
D110.notes: The best-composed couple selfie of the batch — dramatic sky, both laughing rather than posing, a lone red beach chair anchoring the background.

D111.people: Mother and father close together at golden hour by water, he in a teal polo and aviators, she leaning into his shoulder
D111.event: Evening portrait of the couple by the water
D111.theme: Growing together; Growing older; The life we built
D111.notes: Warm low sun turns the treeline behind them gold and both are relaxed and unguarded; the tightest, best-lit two-shot of the parents in this batch. Works as a marriage beat on its own.

D112.people: Father, mother and a third woman in a three-way selfie inside a bright glass-walled building
D112.event: Meeting up with another woman, apparently at an airport or similar terminal
D112.notes: The third woman is not identifiable from the frame and no family context is visible. Cheerful but self-contained.

D113.people: Father in sunglasses in a low-angle selfie with all three daughters piled around him; the youngest drinking from a cup, one girl in a 'Best Sister' shirt
D113.event: Sitting outside together, the girls crowding into a selfie
D113.notes: Four faces stacked at different depths and none of them arranged — the toddler drinks straight through the photo and the eldest leans in laughing. Messy, warm and unrepeatable.

D114.people: The three sisters standing in a row indoors, the two older in matching pink printed tees, the toddler in a pink shirt and headband
D114.event: Posed lineup in matching pink shirts; the printed text is not legible in this frame
D114.notes: Useful as a clean size-order record of the three girls in one frame. The matching shirts clearly mark an occasion but I cannot read what they say.

D115.people: Mother and father behind a table with three daughters; the father cradles a light-coloured bundle, and two girls sit in front with a lit birthday cake
D115.event: A birthday celebration at home with a candle-lit cake and a light-up decoration
D115.theme: Milestones; Home; Family of five; Holidays
D115.notes: Dim room lit mostly by the cake candle and a blue glow, so the exposure is muddy. The bundle in the father's arms is not clearly identifiable in this frame.

D116.people: Mother holding the youngest daughter on a lawn at golden hour, with two daughters in 'THANKFUL' and 'GRATEFUL' sweatshirts beside her
D116.event: Thanksgiving-day photos outside in the late afternoon light
D116.notes: Low warm sun through the trees behind them; the slogan sweatshirts date it precisely to Thanksgiving. Paired with the father's version from the same minutes.

D117.people: Father holding the youngest daughter on the same lawn, with the two older daughters in their 'THANKFUL' and 'GRATEFUL' sweatshirts
D117.event: Thanksgiving-day photos outside, the father's turn with the girls
D117.notes: Direct companion to the mother's frame taken moments earlier — same light, same lawn, parents swapped. Good for a matched cut.

D118.people: The three sisters standing in front of a cut Christmas tree at dusk, bundled in winter coats and hats
D118.event: Picking out a Christmas tree at a tree lot in the evening
D118.notes: Shot into a floodlit tree against a deep blue sky, so the girls are slightly underlit — but the annual tree run with all three sisters is a strong recurring beat.

D119.people: Mother, father and three daughters in winter coats and knit hats in front of massive stone columns of a monument
D119.event: Family photo at a large stone memorial during a winter sightseeing trip
D119.theme: Vacations; Family of five; Adventure; Holidays
D119.notes: The enormous fluted columns fill the frame and dwarf the group; other tourists visible behind. Marks a between-Christmas-and-New-Year trip.

D120.people: No people; a school-project diorama of a decorated room built inside a box, populated with marshmallow Peeps figures and a small typed placard
D120.event: A finished Peeps diorama school project on display
D120.notes: An object photo with no family members in it, shot to record the finished project and its entry card. Evidence of a school assignment rather than a moment.
